detail: `.use(...extras)` hands `.use` something that is not an installer — wrap each plugin as `.use(definePlugin(plugin))` by hand, one call per plugin
`.use(extras)` hands `.use` something that is not an installer — wrap each plugin as `.use(definePlugin(plugin))` by hand, one call per plugin
`.use(extras[0])` hands `.use` something that is not an installer — wrap each plugin as `.use(definePlugin(plugin))` by hand, one call per plugin
`definePlugin` is already declared locally — the `createI18n(…)` chains in this file are left untouched
`.use(metrics())` reads as an installer by its lowercase name and is left as written — if `metrics()` returns a PLUGIN rather than an installer, wrap it as `.use(definePlugin(metrics(…)))`

`app.use(…)` runs a raw plugin on a stored `createI18n(…)` result, and `.use` takes an INSTALLER — compose `.use(plugins())` (or a lowercase installer) where the host is constructed and call `app.registerPlugin(…)` here, or wrap the plugin as `app.use(definePlugin(…))`
